name: Clayton County, GA
findings: Clayton County has 926 nonprofit organizations. 302 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 233 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Clayton County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Clayton County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?
